messages:
AJ (Support): passing to CS — AlphaRetail onboarding is blocked, provisioning hitting 403s on ingest, can't complete live tests. Renewal in ~3 weeks, they're on a Dedicated trial. Ticket TKT-48912. Escalating for priority handling + customer comms plan. TL;DR below.

Maya (CSM): got it — thanks for the heads up. how many seats/customers impacted? any short-term workaround? pinging @Sam (CSOps) to grab the playbook. :eyes:

AJ (Support): only staging/dev: 2 dev seats and their internal QA. Prod not enabled yet but customer is worried it will block GA and renewal. No known workaround — API key returns 403 on provision call. Repro commands show: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision` -> `HTTP/1.1 403 {"error":"forbidden","code":403}`. Tried key rotate, reprovision, region fallback (eu-west/us-east) — same.

Sam (CSOps): on it. marking as high-priority. immediate plan: 1) attempt reprovision from standby control plane 2) if reprovision fails, enable temporary hosted fallback for customer (same model, routed to hosted) 3) schedule 1:1 enablement within 48h and provide post-mortem for the provisioning failure. Proposed comms snippet (please edit):

```
Hi <Customer Team>,

We're prioritizing your onboarding and understand the impact. Here's what we'll do immediately:
- Redeploy provisioning from standby control plane (ETA ~4h)
- If provisioning can't be restored, we'll enable a temporary hosted fallback route so you can continue testing (ETA ~2h)
- Schedule a 1:1 enablement + provisioning walkthrough within 48h
- We'll follow up with a timeline and post-mortem once we have root cause

Contact: Maya (CSM) — maya@redwood.ai, Sam (CSOps) — sam@redwood.ai

Thanks for your patience,
Redwood Support & CS
```

Maya (CSM): that comms draft looks good. I'll own outreach and set the enablement call—please CC renewals. Tagging as `renewal-risk` and `urgent`. If reprovisioning will take longer than 24h we should escalate to exec sponsor.

AJ (Support): sharing the provisioning trace and last error dump in the ticket: https://redwood.inc/t/TKT-48912. Snippet from control-plane logs: `provision_service::error: unable to write tenant-config: permission denied (403) trace_id=abc123`.

ops-bot: Ticket TKT-48912 has been marked HIGH by AJ (Support). Pager duty notified for on-call infra.

Maya (CSM): thanks — Sam, can you post the finalized comms in this channel and I'll schedule the call and loop in renewals & AM (Lena). If infra needs exec escalation I'll coordinate with Partnerships/GTN.

Sam (CSOps): will post edited comms in ~30m and start reprovision attempt now. leaving a note in TKT-48912 for any handoffs.

AJ (Support): thanks team — i'll keep the ticket updated with any new logs. :thumbsup:
